summary: Tested the fix for 'only 1 owner payment' in Liquidaciones, where pagoPropietario (one payment) became the pagosPropietario list. BACKEND: the main agent's 20 tests pass (pago_propietario + liquidaciones_pendientes + liq_recordatorio_extra), and the new file test_rentals_pagos_propietario_iter93.py passes 7/7. It checks: the reported case (net 180k, then a 100k payment gives 'parcial' with 80k left, then 80k more gives 'pagado' with 0 left and both payments listed); paying too much (balance stays 0, never negative); deleting one payment that has a receipt (the other payment is unaffected and GET comprobantes/{cid} gives 404 afterwards); validation (bad method 400, amount 0 or negative 400, missing amount 422, unknown reservation 404); the old endpoints (marcar-pagada, revertir, pagar, pago, GET liquidacion/comprobante) give 404/405; old single-payment ('legado') data, injected directly in Mongo: shown as id 'legado', added up with new payments, deletable with DELETE .../pagos/legado; pendientes includes 'parcial' reservations with the right saldoLiquidacion and drops them once fully paid; the PDF lists each payment with capitalized methods (Transferencia/Efectivo/Cheque) plus 'Liquidación completa' or 'Saldo pendiente de pago'. FRONTEND (/veraos/liquidaciones as qa_varela, on a TEST_ property with net 180k): status lines, payment chips, form that stays visible after full payment, Liquidada/Parcial/Sin liquidar badges, Pendientes/Historial tabs, Historial total, reminder banner with 'falta $X', opening a reservation from the banner, deleting one chip and validation message all work. One UX issue: after adding a payment the form keeps the old amount and notes.

minor.issue: Returns 204 for an unknown pagoId and for an unknown reservation; 404 would be clearer. Deleting a receipt only removes the entry from the reservation's comprobantes list; the file stays in Supabase storage as an orphan.

Old single payments stored their receipt inline (pagoPropietario.comprobante with bucket/object_path), and the old GET /liquidacion/comprobante endpoint was removed. The 'legado' payment is always shown with comprobanteId=None, so receipts already uploaded in production can no longer be opened from the UI. DELETE legado clears the field but leaves the storage object. Suggested fix: when reading legacy data, move the inline comprobante into r.comprobantes and expose its id.

Items include estadoLiquidacion and saldoLiquidacion but not totalPagadoPropietario, although the review request says they do. Each reservation also triggers its own movements query and property lookup (N+1); fine at the current size.
If Supabase is not configured, an uploaded file is silently dropped and the payment is saved without a receipt.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Agregar pago' succeeds, the amount and notes keep the values just submitted instead of being refilled with the new remaining balance. Reproduced: net 180k, pay 100k; the amount field still shows 100000 and the notes 'TEST transf 1'. A second click would record a duplicate payment, and the next payment is not prefilled with the 80k left. Cause: the useEffect that sets pagoForm only depends on liq?.reserva.id. Fix: in agregarPago(), after recargar(), reset pagoForm (monto = new saldoLiquidacion, notas = '') and setPagoFile(null).
The trash button deletes the payment immediately, with no confirmation and no undo. On mobile it is easy to tap by accident.

issues: The payment form inputs (date, method, amount, notes) are smaller and visually different from the 'Ajustar movimientos' row just below.
The banner title always says '...sin liquidar todavía', even when the list includes partially paid reservations. Consider '...sin liquidar o con saldo pendiente'.
The chip text (green on dark green, small font) is readable but low in contrast.

action_items: Reset or refill the payment form after a successful 'Agregar pago' (amount = new saldoLiquidacion, notes empty, file cleared) to prevent duplicate payments.
Legacy compat: expose the old inline pagoPropietario.comprobante (move it into r.comprobantes with an id) so receipts uploaded in production can still be opened.
Optional: return 404 from DELETE pagos/{id} when the payment or reservation does not exist; delete the storage object when a receipt is removed; add a confirmation before deleting a payment chip.
critical_code_review_comments: _neto_y_estado_liquidacion() and _liquidacion_reserva() duplicate the neto, total paid, balance and status logic; _liquidacion_reserva should call the helper.
routes_rentals.py is about 2000 lines; consider splitting the liquidaciones routes into their own module.
Adding payments with $push is atomic, so concurrent adds are safe.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 medium UX bug in the form reset)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ properties and reservations only, deleted afterwards by id. A161 is back to its original state: 4 reservations, all pendiente, 0 payments. No TEST_ properties remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /veraos/login (not /login). The liquidables endpoint only lists reservations whose pago.estado is 'pagado'. A manual reservation created without a seña does not set this, so tests set pago.estado and pago.pagadoEl directly in Mongo (see the _mongo helper in the iter93 test file). _iter93_ui_setup.py setup|cleanup creates and removes a TEST property and reservation with net 180k for UI tests. The environment date is about 2026-11-14.
